summary: Art Director and Creative Lead with over five years of experience in the gaming industry, specializing in visual storytelling and immersive player experiences. Expert in defining visual, audio, and narrative guidelines to ensure cohesive game worlds. Proven track record of directing cross-functional art teams, managing creative pipelines, and optimizing asset production for PC, mobile, and VR titles. Adept at bridging the gap between creative innovation and technical feasibility.

experience.title: Art Director & Senior Game Designer
bullets: Lead the development and implementation of visual, audio, and narrative guidelines ensuring a cohesive and immersive player experience.
Direct a team of artists and optimize internal workflows to maintain visual consistency and high-quality standards across all game assets and marketing materials.
Design core gameplay systems for PC and mobile titles, ensuring mechanics align with the established artistic and creative vision.
Author detailed Game Design Documents (GDDs) and facilitate collaboration between design and engineering teams to balance innovation with technical feasibility.

experience.title: Game Production Manager
bullets: Led the development of VR fitness applications, balancing creative ambitions with technical constraints to deliver polished, user-centric products.
Collaborated with engineering teams to ensure design intent was maintained throughout the development cycle.

experience.title: Design Manager
bullets: Directed art and creative pipelines for live-service PC and mobile games, ensuring efficient asset delivery.
Collaborated with executive leadership to align creative direction with business goals and developed production schedules using Agile methodologies.
Conceptualized and developed 3D race maps and created in-game features, leading a team of artists to ensure a cohesive vision.
Spearheaded the creation of engaging tutorials and lore videos, managing scriptwriting and video editing to support the game's narrative.

experience.title: Lead Content Creator
bullets: Oversaw the production schedule for the gaming team, including scriptwriting and video editing.
Conducted interviews with developers to provide exclusive insights and narratives for upcoming games.

experience.title: Social Media Executive
bullets: Led creative pitches to clients and managed communication for promotional campaigns.

experience.title: Project Manager
bullets: Facilitated communication for major clients including Netflix, Disney Channel, and AAA game studios.
Managed the full production lifecycle (pre-production, production, post-production) to ensure creative requirements were met.

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Spearheaded the development of new youth products and created targeted marketing campaigns.
